doctors.name: Dr. Amit Goel
doctors.about: Dr. Amit Goel is a seniors gastroenterologist and hepatologist with more than 22 years of experience. He specializes in liver transplantation, advanced endoscopy, and management of complex liver diseases. He has performed over 1000 liver transplants and is known for pioneering minimally invasive techniques in gastroenterology.
education: MBBS – King George’s Medical University, Lucknow
DM – Gastroenterology, Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences

doctors.name: Dr. Arun Saroha
doctors.about: Dr. Arun Saroha is an internationally acclaimed neurosurgeon with more than 25 years of experience in performing complex brain and spine surgeries. He has successfully treated over 8000 patients from India and abroad, with special expertise in minimally invasive neurosurgical techniques.
education: MS – General Surgery, RNT Medical College
awards: Best Spine Surgeon Award – Indian Healthcare Awards 2018
Life Member – Neurological Society of India (NSI)

doctors.name: Dr. Kaushal Yadav
doctors.designation: Associate Director & Unit Head – Surgical Oncology
doctors.about: Dr. Kaushal Yadav has over 20 years of experience in treating complex cancer patients using advanced and robotic surgical methods. He has performed more than 5000 cancer surgeries and is recognized internationally, having served as a visiting consultant in Uzbekistan, Kenya, and Sudan.
education: M.Ch. in Surgical Oncology – Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai
M.S. in General Surgery – PGIMS, Rohtak
previousPositions: Consultant – Surgical Oncology, Max Hospital, Gurgaon
Senior Consultant & Head – Surgical Oncology, Paras Hospital, Gurgaon
Senior Consultant & Head – Surgical Oncology, Pratiksha Hospital, Gurgaon
Senior Consultant & Head – Surgical Oncology, Narayana Healthcare, Gurgaon
awards: Best Oncologist of the Year – Financial Express 2024
Best Surgical Oncologist in Delhi NCR Award – 2019
publications: Laparoscopic Right Radical Hemicolectomy: CVL and CME, World J Gastrointestinal Surgery, 2024
Portocaval Paraganglioma: First case report, Journal of Gastrointestinal Cancer
Post-hepatectomy Liver Failure, Journal of GI Cancer, 2014
RPLND in Testicular Malignancies, Clinical and Translational Oncology, 2017

doctors.name: Dr. Ravinder
doctors.about: Dr. Ravinder is a senior ENT and head & neck surgeon with more than 18 years of experience. He specializes in cochlear implants, sinus surgeries, and head & neck tumor surgeries. He has successfully treated patients from India and abroad with advanced ENT care.
education: MBBS – Maulana Azad Medical College, New Delhi
awards: Gold Medal in MS ENT – AIIMS
